title: Mixed Third-Order Flux Laws for Dual Cascade in the Stochastic SQG Equation
summary: We study dual-cascade flux laws for the stochastic forced--dissipative surface quasi-geostrophic (SQG) equation on a large periodic box. For statistically stationary solutions, under a weak anomalous dissipation assumption, we derive rigorous mixed third-order structure-function laws for the dual cascade: a Yaglom-type law for the direct cascade of surface potential energy (SPE) and a mixed flux law for the inverse cascade of the Hamiltonian.
